text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Master. I used my day off to recharge my energy levels.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. I switched to sleep mode, and kept other bodily functions such as breathing and blinking to a minimum.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Consequently, I have successfully eliminated my fatigue and am now refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Now switching to active mode. I look forward to our training today.
